description: An isolated dense dark-gray smoke plume from an unseen faulty fryer. Three compact rounded charcoal and desaturated slate smoke lobes rise from a narrow bottom-center source. Thick silhouette, two or three flat dark-gray tones, small transparent holes, complete contained plume. No fryer, fire, appliance or face. Strict native one-pixel-grid pixel art for DREAMS, a dark abandoned fast-food restaurant at 320x180 native resolution. Effect only, transparent background, hard opaque pixel clusters, limited supplied palette. No anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, blur, glow, drawn background lighting, characters, text, furniture or other objects. Static camera and fixed canvas; no zoom or global position/scale jitter. Canvas exactly 32x48 pixels.

reference_images.usage_description: Native pixel density and flat pixel rendering only. Create the requested different VFX, not this steam shape.
